description: This source file defines the internal class ActivationCollector responsible for managing, scheduling, and deactivating grain activations within the Orleans runtime. It includes methods for collecting idle activations, handling memory pressure, scheduling collection, and lifecycle participation, as well as internal classes and logging functionality.

classes.name: ActivationCollector
classes.description: Manages activation lifecycle, including scheduling for cleanup, memory pressure detection, and deactivation of grain activations.

classes.name: ActivationCollector.Bucket
classes.description: Internal class representing a bucket holding collectible grain contexts, with methods for addition, removal, and cancellation of all items.

classes.name: ActivationCollector.ActivationsLogValue
classes.description: Structure for logging a list of activations.

methods.name: GetNumRecentlyUsed
methods.description: Returns the number of activations used within a recent time window.

methods.name: CollectActivations
methods.description: Initiates collection of activations that have been idle longer than a specified age limit.

methods.name: ScheduleCollection
methods.description: Schedules a specific grain context for collection if it becomes idle for a given timeout.

methods.name: TryCancelCollection
methods.description: Attempts to cancel the scheduled collection for a grain context.

methods.name: TryRescheduleCollection
methods.description: Attempts to reschedule collection for a grain context.

methods.name: TryRescheduleCollection_Impl
methods.description: Internal implementation for rescheduling activation collection.

methods.name: DequeueQuantum
methods.description: Dequeues activations due for collection based on quantum timing.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the activation collector status.

methods.name: ScanStale
methods.description: Scans for stale (idle) activations eligible for collection.

methods.name: ScanAll
methods.description: Scans all activation buckets for activations idle over a specific age limit.

methods.name: IsMemoryOverloaded
methods.description: Checks if environment memory usage is over configured limits and calculates surplus activations to deactivate.

methods.name: DeactivateInDueTimeOrder
methods.description: Deactivates a number of activations in order of next scheduled time, used for handling memory pressure.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Begins the background tasks for collection and memory pressure handling.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops background collection tasks and disposes resources.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Registers this collector with the silo lifecycle for start and stop.

methods.name: RunActivationCollectionLoop
methods.description: Main loop for periodic activation collection.

methods.name: RunMemoryBasedDeactivationLoop
methods.description: Loop for memory pressure checking and triggering deactivation of excess activations.

methods.name: CollectActivationsImpl
methods.description: Performs collection of either stale or all activations based on parameters.

methods.name: DeactivateActivationsFromCollector
methods.description: Deactivates a list of activations, possibly in parallel.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes timers and cancellation tokens.
